<quote by="Proposed: Upwold, Seconded: Karov">Construct Yakholme Grange in Stockland, Upwold. A great work increasing taxation and investment in farms. Self funded by the Marches.

==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Stock March, [[Upwold]]
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Wild_is_the_wind#Yakholme_Grange|Wild is the wind]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Autumn 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 50 wains of weirwood
* 25 wains of white granite
* 225 crowns in labour costs
* Six months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Yakholme_Grange}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, raises the level of investment for farms in Upwold by one, establishes Stockland as the Empire's premier cattle market, and increases Faraden trade with the Marches
